questions.prompt: A EUR/USD candle: open 1.09200, high 1.09350, low 1.09150, close 1.09300. How big is its body?

options.explanation: No: that is the range, high minus low.

questions.prompt: Four H1 candles have highs 1.2510, 1.2525, 1.2518 and 1.2505. What is the high of the H4 candle they make?

options.explanation: Right: the H4 high is the highest of the four highs.
No: that is the last candle's high.
No: that is the average of the four highs. The H4 high is the highest one.

questions.prompt: Swing highs 1.3200, 1.3150, 1.3080. Swing lows 1.3100, 1.3020. What do the swings describe?

options.explanation: Right: lower highs and lower lows.
No: the highs and lows are both falling.
No: the swings step down rather than overlap.

questions.prompt: Swing highs keep turning near 1.1100 and swing lows near 1.1020. What is this, and how high is it?

options.explanation: No: the swings are not rising.

questions.prompt: An uptrend's last higher low is 1.27400. A candle closes at 1.27350. What is the best description now?

options.explanation: Right: a lower low breaks the pattern, but a downtrend also needs a lower high.

options.text: A confirmed downtrend has started, so this is a signal to sell
options.explanation: No: a break of structure changes the description. It is not a signal.

options.text: The uptrend is still intact, since it was only a small dip
options.explanation: No: price closed 5 pips below the last higher low, so the pattern of higher lows is broken.

questions.prompt: The D1 chart shows an uptrend. The M15 chart shows the last 3 hours falling. What is true?

options.text: Both can be true at once
options.explanation: Right: a short fall can sit inside a longer rise.

options.text: One of the charts must be wrong
options.explanation: No: they show the same prices over different windows of time.
